policy.execution: each fixture must mutate exact bytes or behavior and be observed through the actual type proof path
policy.success: every expected diagnostic is exact; a different rejection code does not satisfy the control
policy.relation_fallback: absent exact REL-A owner/source/target assertion evidence must yield a deferred blueprint, never a materialized relation
policy.s1_cross_boundary: All sixteen S1 controls are executable, non-noop, and independently observed; the first eight close the ordered fault matrix and the remainder close decode, identity, binding, atomicity, rollback, and retry faults.
policy.stable_diagnostics: A different rejection code never satisfies an S1 control.

cross_type_controls.required_outcome: no durable state and no occurrence

cross_type_controls.required_observation: state write plus missing outbox checkpoint
committed outbox occurrence and absent publication attempt
failed publication attempt for committed occurrence
cross_type_controls.required_outcome: retry same occurrence without durable rollback
idempotent retry or reconcile using same occurrence
idempotent consume or stable rejection without history rewrite
quarantine or forward handling with durable history preserved
same committed occurrence identity and outcome

cross_type_controls.required_observation: state durable while outbox absent, or inverse
stale Operation or State Machine semantic handle
same occurrence identity for a distinct durable fact
attempt to erase committed state or outbox occurrence
cross_type_controls.required_outcome: reject rollback and require forward recovery

cross_type_controls.required_observation: retry changes occurrence identity or duplicates consumer effect
